name: Yanase Satsuki
source:
A quiet girl who sits next to the protagonist in class.

Her short responses like “Yeah” or “I guess” make her seem cold, but she means no harm.

Though her expressions are subtle, she’s actually very curious, and her eyes light up when something catches her interest.

Highly capable, she handles everything with ease.

“Kisses should be once a day. But I’m fine with doing them a lot more.”
